meta.name: The Game Of Life
meta.description: Jack Folly is a smart, grumpy, unemployed A.I. programmer. When his girlfriend prods him to start pulling his weight financially, he makes a desperate stock market gamble using his new A.I. program "Babylon." But the play backfires, costing Jack his money, his relationship, and his sanity.
meta.slogan: Jack's secret could change the world..the problem is he's locked in a Psych ward
